description: Kelso Stormwater Catchment Flood Study is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canterbury-Bankstown Council. Study Area The study area is largely located within the Sydney suburb of Panania. The study area includes the entire Kelso Creek catchment, from the stormwater pipe network in the upper catchment to Kelso Creek, which flows through Kelso Park and eventually joins the Georges River. Coverage: Canterbury-Bankstown Council. The portal files it under the publisher Canterbury-Bankstown Council. Its tags are Kelso, Panania, hydraulic model. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
